reviewer.runtime_model_attestation: Requested orchestration labels, not an independently attested cross-model review.

resolved_findings.title: Concurrent read of the primary collector's truncate-in-place collection.json
resolved_findings.evidence: collect_results.py writes collection.json with Path.write_text while its watcher is active; the earlier suite watcher repeatedly parsed that file during writes.
resolved_findings.resolution: collect_full_suite.py now requires --primary-receipt in watch mode, waits 240 seconds between reads until the existing primary stdout contains TERMINAL_PUBLISHED, then reads collection.json once and requires nine completed runs and no failures.

resolved_findings.title: Overlapping canonical-handoff and Git publication
resolved_findings.evidence: The primary collector writes completed==9 before its final git add, commit and push. The earlier suite gate therefore allowed analyze() and the second publisher to begin while the first publisher was still active.
resolved_findings.resolution: TERMINAL_PUBLISHED is emitted only after the primary collector's successful push. The suite now waits for that marker before analyze(), handoff updates or publication. The running primary collector is unchanged.

resolved_findings.title: First-epoch failure evidence omitted by the completed-epoch condition
resolved_findings.evidence: The preserved initial RGBNT100 ordinary failure has exit_code 1, no status.json and 18 batch_orders.jsonl rows. The earlier if row['epoch'] intake condition would skip both training text files and still mark intake complete.
resolved_findings.resolution: read_host now records the existing epochs.csv and batch_orders.jsonl filenames. Terminal intake copies every present training text file regardless of the completed epoch count.

checks: The schedule covers exactly 27 unique dataset/variant/seed tuples: all three datasets, all three variants and seeds 42/43/44; 13 checkpoints on host 2025 and 14 on host 2026.
Remote state intake reads existing files only. Training and evaluation exit receipts gate terminal intake; either nonzero exit takes precedence over available metrics and marks FAILED.

COMPLETE requires full metrics plus both exit codes zero. The reviewed full_evaluation producer writes those metrics only after requiring a COMPLETE training result, loading the dev-selected checkpoint strictly, and completing all evaluations. The final aggregate independently requires result.COMPLETE, 50 epochs and both exit codes zero.

Per-run receipts and stdout are preserved. Existing training CSV and sample-order logs are retained even for a failure before the first completed epoch. There is no rerun or training-process control path.

All 27 result audits require epoch rows 1 through 50, earliest maximum development mAP, consistent selected metrics, consecutive batch-attempt numbering, B64 filenames, optimizer-update and AMP-skip totals, and their per-epoch cumulative accounting.
Full sample order is compared among all three variants within every dataset and seed. Ordinary and dual total/trainable parameter counts and 5632-dimensional evaluation descriptors must agree.

Development evaluation metrics must agree with the saved strict-reload metrics, and the evaluated checkpoint epoch must match the development selection. Official test never participates in checkpoint selection.

All six metrics are aggregated over exactly three seeds with statistics.mean and statistics.stdev, giving sample standard deviation. All variants and both development/official-test scopes are retained, including negative differences.

Paired-query joins require equal query index, filename, identity, camera, scene and validity. Rank-1 harms and rescues are counted in opposite directions over the same valid queries; percentages explicitly use all valid queries as denominator.

The FULL_SUITE marker replaces only the suite section in the canonical handoff. Every collection synchronizes the same document bytes through the existing mirror function; the final audited text is synchronized again before Git commit and push.

A failure stops this watcher after preserving and publishing the failed state; it does not fabricate a 27-run aggregate. Waiting uses 240-second intervals and does not modify existing training or evaluation processes.
Uses the real official dataset parsers, checks camera-embedding coverage, decodes the first query/gallery triplets, and records actual valid-query counts.

Recomputes full metrics from an existing best_dev_arrays.npz and requires agreement with the saved best mAP and Rank-1/5/10 before writing its PASS receipt. The script does not build a model or run GPU inference.
Both existing host receipts report all queries valid: RGBNT201 836/836 query/gallery, RGBNT100 1715/8575, and MSVR310 591/1055.

The two receipts retain distinct real MSVR310 development results: host 2025 mAP 47.60779210388089 and mINP 33.521766571761695; host 2026 mAP 46.75519502956051 and mINP 31.45428490411944. These are CPU preflight evidence, not completed three-seed results.

performed_checks: Read both new scripts and their existing collector, launcher, evaluator, analyzer and training-log interfaces.
Compiled both final Python sources and the generated remote-reader source without executing their main functions.
Evaluated only the static schedule expressions: 27 unique jobs, nine per seed, host counts 13 and 14.
Evaluated seven status-expression cases covering QUEUED, TRAINING, WAIT_EVALUATION, EVALUATING, COMPLETE and both training/evaluation failures; all matched the intended precedence.
Read the two saved CPU preflight receipts and confirmed the reported complete query-validity counts.
Verified the preserved real first-epoch failure has both training text files, no status.json and 18 persisted batch records, then inspected the corrected existence-based intake.
execution_condition: Launch the watcher with --primary-receipt pointing to the existing current primary collector stdout. Its terminal publication marker, nine collected primary completions and no primary failures are required before the suite begins collection and analysis.
boundaries: This verdict approves the reviewed orchestration source. It does not state that all 27 runs, all evaluations or the 1350-epoch audit have already completed.
The CPU receipts establish real parser/metric preflight results; the reviewer did not rerun them or execute model inference.

The final scientific interpretation remains a three-seed comparison trained on fixed fit subsets, not full-official-training paper reproduction, SOTA proof or isolated attribution to the joint interaction term.
